title: AI just put Minecraft inside GTA V

scenes.headline: AI BUILT *THIS*
scenes.say: An AI coding agent built this! Real Minecraft, running inside {GTA V|GTA Five}.
Mobs versus the {LSPD|L S P D}. Halo's Warthog, in Minecraft. Even a World at War flamethrower!
It's called Universal Modder, and it passed {5,000|five thousand} GitHub stars in just over a week!

scenes.heading: HOW IT *WORKS*
steps: Tests it in the running game
scenes.say: Point Claude Code, Codex or Gemini at a game you own. It reads the real code, builds the mod, makes the art and sound, and tests it in-game.

pros: Any game you own, even servers you host
scenes.say: The catch: the art and sound use fal, which is pay per use, and it refuses online games with anti-cheat. The plugin itself is free and open source.
Which game would you mod first? Comment {MOD|mod} and I'll pin the link.
